questions.question: When checking the exhaust system, it should be:
questions.explanation: All parts of the exhaust system must be tight and secure. Nothing should be loose, broken, or missing.

questions.question: When traveling down a hill, you can reduce braking by:
questions.explanation: Before going downhill, slow down and shift to a lower gear. This helps control your vehicle without using too much braking. Using brakes too much downhill can cause them to overheat and fail.

questions.question: A broken exhaust system can:

options.text: Let poisonous fumes into the cab.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let poisonous fumes into the cab.
questions.explanation: A broken exhaust system is very dangerous. Poisonous fumes can enter the cab or sleeper berth.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, you should:

options.text: Make eye contact with the driver.

questions.explanation: Get out of an aggressive driver's way. Do not make eye contact, speed up, or respond to angry gestures. Stay calm and avoid the conflict.

questions.question: After changing a tire, stop a short distance ahead to:

options.text: Check the tightness of the lug nuts.
Ensure that the tire tread depth is good.
Ensure that the correct tire was changed.
See if rocks have gotten into the tread.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the tightness of the lug nuts.
questions.explanation: After changing a tire, always stop a short distance later to check that the lug nuts are still tight.

questions.question: When a tire goes flat and you hear a loud bang, the truck is affected:

options.text: Only if the damaged tire is near the front of the truck.
Only if the truck is hauling a load.

questions.explanation: There is a short delay between when a tire fails and when you feel the effect. This delay may make you think the sound came from another vehicle.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, turning toward the driver's side is best because:

options.text: It allows the driver a better view.
Turning toward the passenger side is illegal.

questions.correctAnswerText: It allows the driver a better view.
questions.explanation: Back toward the driver's side when possible. This gives you the best view of where you are going.

questions.question: Distracted driving:

options.text: Only happens when drivers physically do something, like using a cell phone.
Can happen when the mind is distracted, such as daydreaming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can happen when the mind is distracted, such as daydreaming.
questions.explanation: Mental distractions are just as dangerous as physical ones. You can look at a hazard but fail to notice it if your mind is on something else.

questions.question: Texting while driving should:
questions.explanation: Texting while driving is dangerous and is not allowed at any time when operating a commercial vehicle.

questions.question: To warn drivers behind you that you are slowing down, you should:
questions.explanation: Lightly tap your brakes to make the brake lights flash. This alerts drivers behind you that you are slowing down.

questions.question: Why are roads especially slippery when it first starts to rain?

options.text: Rain mixes with oil on the road.
The water has nowhere to go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Rain mixes with oil on the road.
questions.explanation: Roads are very slippery when rain first falls. The water mixes with oil already on the road, creating a slippery surface.

questions.question: When driving on packed snow, how much should you reduce your speed?
questions.explanation: On packed snow, reduce your speed by half or more. It is hard to stop or turn on slippery surfaces, so you must drive more slowly.

questions.question: What can happen if cargo is loaded improperly?

options.text: It can look bad to other drivers.
It can injure the driver during a quick stop.
It makes it easier to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can injure the driver during a quick stop.
questions.explanation: Cargo must be loaded and secured correctly. During a quick stop, poorly loaded cargo could fall and injure the driver.

questions.question: Which is NOT a reason to cover cargo?

options.text: To protect people from spilled cargo

questions.explanation: Cover cargo to protect people if it spills and to protect the cargo from weather. Protecting cargo from animals is not a main reason to cover cargo.

questions.question: Why should you be careful around rental trucks?

options.text: Rental vehicles are usually not insured.
Drivers are usually worried about their cargo.
Drivers may not know about the truck's limited side and rear views.
They do not respond as well as other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may not know about the truck's limited side and rear views.
questions.explanation: Be cautious around rental trucks because drivers may not be used to the truck's limited views to the sides and rear. Drivers who cannot see others are dangerous.

questions.question: What should you use when parked on the side of the road?
questions.explanation: Turn on your four-way emergency flashers when parked on the side of the road. This is very important at night.

questions.question: On the vehicle inspection test, which do you NOT have to do?

options.text: Point to or touch each item.
Explain what you are checking and why.

questions.explanation: For the inspection test, you will walk around the vehicle, point to or touch each item, and explain what you are checking and why. You do not have to crawl under the vehicle or hood.

questions.question: What should a school bus driver watch for as students exit?

options.text: That they are leaving in pairs.
That they do not get caught on the handrail or door.
That they do not talk while exiting.

questions.correctAnswerText: That they do not get caught on the handrail or door.
questions.explanation: Students can be injured or killed if their clothing, accessories, or bodies get caught on a handrail or door. Watch closely as students exit the bus to make sure they are safe.

questions.question: What is true about hanging meat as cargo?

options.text: It is illegal to transport in most states.
It is always easy to transport.

questions.explanation: Hanging meat cargo is unstable because it has a high center of gravity and the meat swings, which affects how you handle the vehicle.

questions.question: If your brakes fail on a downgrade, what is your best option to stop?
questions.explanation: If your brakes fail on a downgrade, use an escape ramp. This is the safest way to stop your vehicle.
